changes.comment: Extract the built-in Codex runtime into the publishable @excitedjs/agent-runtime-codex package and depend on it by default (issue #209 slice 3). `builtin:codex` loads through the provider package loader/catalog and implements the neutral @excitedjs/dreamux-types AgentRuntimeProvider contract; core supplies only the neutral create-context values (identity, role, cwd, MCP descriptors, skill sources, state callbacks, path context, logger, and env injection seam). Codex-specific process, socket, handshake, diagnostics, config, and completion-delivery logic live in the runtime package. The builtin:codex alias, runtime semantics, config, paths, and state are unchanged; no operator action required on upgrade.
